BiblicalUsage: Maknadbai is named once, in Ezra 10:40, in the list of those who had taken strange wives and were called to put them away. He is named among those who had taken strange wives, and his name is on the list of those called to put them away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in a repentance list is a hard kind of honesty: Maknadbai's sin was written down, and so was his turning.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
